div.div: 189 items from the news desk's seven default feeds: all 17,766 item pairs, plus each item with a reworded copy of itself. Spearman 0.770 between the two models' cosines. Amber: a cutoff and the share of pairs above it; grey: a median. scripts/calibrate_embeddings.py, 19 November 2026.
